name: Sky Archipelago
desc: Chunks of land torn loose and hung in the air — broken rock undersides trailing thin ribbon waterfalls into the void, cloud strata sliding between them, each island floating on its own incommensurate drift so the sky never repeats; a golden-hour dusk, a slate storm, a pastel dawn, a lush verdant midday, or a monochrome sumi ink wash.

energy.doc: waterfall brightness, cloud luminance and overall light — how much the scene glows

scale.doc: island size — from a distant scattered archipelago to huge islands filling the frame

density.doc: how many islands, clouds and birds populate the sky

speed.doc: drift rate — near islands and clouds always slide faster than far ones

haze.doc: atmosphere — aerial-perspective blue-out with distance and how veiled the far islands and waterfall mist read

bob.doc: how much the islands rise and fall on slow air currents

hue.doc: primary sky/light hue shift off the default golden dusk

x.doc: horizontal bias of the light and horizon glow

y.doc: the atmospheric horizon — how much frame is deep sky versus hazy void below

style.doc: aesthetic: dusk = golden-hour warm-lit tops, cool violet undersides; storm = slate sky, near-black islands, pale cold falls; dawn = pastel pink & lavender, soft high-key; verdant = lush greens over bright teal void; ink = abstracted monochrome sumi wash, islands as ink masses, waterfalls as bare paper

seed.doc: regenerates the island shapes, layout, waterfalls and vegetation

alpha.doc: layer opacity — sinks the whole archipelago back behind the performers
